limitations: Mocked protocol execution does not establish rendering, codecs/devices, platform capture behavior, live streaming, or real OBS performance.

tools.name: list_inputs

tools.title: Get OBS Input Mute
tools.description: Return whether an OBS input is muted.

tools.name: set_input_mute
tools.title: Set OBS Input Mute
tools.description: Set whether an OBS input is muted.

tools.name: toggle_input_mute
tools.title: Toggle OBS Input Mute
tools.description: Toggle whether an OBS input is muted.

tools.name: get_input_volume
tools.title: Get OBS Input Volume
tools.description: Return an OBS input volume in multiplier and dB units.

tools.name: get_input_settings
tools.title: Get OBS Input Settings
tools.description: Return raw inputKind and inputSettings for an OBS input. Keys and values are source-kind-specific and reflect the current OBS/plugin/OS surface.

tools.name: set_input_settings
tools.title: Set OBS Input Settings
tools.description: Apply free-form, source-kind-specific OBS inputSettings verbatim. Use snake_case OBS keys discovered from get_input_default_settings, get_input_properties_list_property_items, and get_input_settings; there is no universal key list.

tools.name: get_output_settings
tools.title: Get OBS Output Settings
tools.description: Return sanitized, typed settings for a generic OBS output by name.

tools.name: set_output_settings
tools.title: Set OBS Output Settings
tools.description: Update sanitized, typed settings for a generic OBS output by name.

tools.name: get_record_status
tools.title: Get OBS Record Status
tools.description: Return the active, paused, timecode, duration, and byte count status for the OBS record output.

tools.name: start_record
tools.title: Start OBS Recording
tools.description: Start the OBS record output.

tools.name: stop_record
tools.title: Stop OBS Recording
tools.description: Stop the OBS record output and return OBS-provided output metadata.

tools.name: get_stream_status
tools.title: Get OBS Stream Status
tools.description: Return OBS stream output activity, reconnecting state, timing, congestion, byte, and frame counts.

tools.name: list_scene_transitions
tools.title: List OBS Scene Transitions
tools.description: Return current scene transition identity and stable transition summaries.

tools.name: get_current_scene_transition
tools.title: Get Current OBS Scene Transition
tools.description: Return current scene transition identity, kind, fixed-duration state, and configured duration.

tools.name: set_current_scene_transition_settings
tools.title: Set Current OBS Scene Transition Settings
tools.description: Set current OBS scene transition settings using a flat primitive settings record; overlay defaults to true and merges over existing settings, while false replaces them.
